scores.note: Cold reader can follow s01 double life->s02 red pill->s03 pods/Zion->s07 bullet-stop via ending_first, but s05 Oracle verdict vague and jacket_copy cuts off mid-sentence.
World (Matrix as dream/farm, scorched sky, Zion, Nebuchadnezzar hovercraft) withheld until s03 awakening where Neo needs it, not dumped in s01-s02.
Neo/Trinity s01 white rabbit, Smith s02 mouth-seal/tracker, Morpheus s02 choice, Oracle/Cypher s05 betrayal context; all via action, Cypher late.
Core chain s02 capture->s03 truth->s05 Cypher deal->s06 rescue->s07 death/kiss holds, but s07 Trinity love prophecy lacks setup in s01-s04 beyond s04 quiet faith.
Seven beats s01 cracks to s07 death/awakening plus ending_first coda map to setup/revelation/training/betrayal/choice/rebirth transformation arc.
Matrix s03 shared dream, red/blue pill s02, Nebuchadnezzar s03 hovercraft, Zion s03 last city, the One s04 prophecy all glossed inline at first use.
s01-s07 present-tense is fluent but 878 words dense, ending_first duplicates s07, and jacket_copy ends mid-sentence 'save one he' breaking fluency.
Neo likeable via vulnerability s01 chewed out/s04 failed leap/doubt and open heart s02 refuses betrayal/s06 wagers on Morpheus despite disbelief.
Belief vs doubt s04 knowing vs walking, freedom vs comfortable lie s05 Cypher, faith/love as resurrection s07 woven into action, not abstract.
